candidates.title: Navajo curse on the land after Ute-US alliance
candidates.quote: in the 19th century the area primarily consisted of two indian tribes the navajo and the youths during the civil war the utes partnered with the us government in a battle against the navajo suffering a brutal defeat and feeling betrayed the navajo cursed the local land with skinwalkers

link.reason: Same legend: the Utes allied with the US government against the Navajo, and the Navajo cursed the land with skinwalkers.
link.difference: Places it in the Civil War era and says the Navajo suffered a brutal defeat.

candidates.title: Sherman family haunted off the ranch
candidates.quote: in the 90s a family named the shermans took over the ranch and were basically haunted off the property they encountered orbs ufos skin walkers and even got rushed by an oversized bipedal wolf that they claimed was able to withstand a close range attack from a shotgun

link.reason: The nearest story covers the former family's cattle mutilations together with Bigelow's experiments as a whole. The Shermans being driven off by orbs and a shotgun-proof wolf is a narrower, distinct account.

candidates.title: Government UFO program at Skinwalker Ranch under Bigelow Aerospace
candidates.quote: between 2007 and 2012 it became the center of study for atip the official government ufo program led by lou elizondo because this program was also run under the auspices of bigelow aerospace a private company all of the data from it is both classified and not subject to the freedom of information act

link.reason: Same 2007-2012 government UFO study program based at Skinwalker Ranch and run through Bigelow.
link.difference: Calls it AATIP led by Lou Elizondo, not OSAP under Harry Reid, and adds that the data is classified and exempt from FOIA because Bigelow Aerospace ran it.

candidates.title: Heifer found dead with UFO-shaped object above it on footage

link.reason: No story covers a healthy heifer found dead with no injuries and a UFO-shaped object on the footage. The cattle-mutilation story is about the earlier family's era in general.

candidates.title: Drilling into the mesa hits a 400-foot buried metallic object

link.reason: Same claim of an object located beneath the mesa at Skinwalker Ranch.
link.difference: Adds that it was found with soil resistivity and ground-penetrating radar, that it is a large metallic object about 400 feet down, and credits Blunt and Chandran.

candidates.title: Rocket over the Triangle swerves as a UFO appears

link.reason: Same event: a UAP appears above the Triangle during a rocket launch at Skinwalker Ranch.

candidates.title: Hitchhiker effects among ranch scientists
candidates.quote: in skinwalkers at the pentagon colm kelleher george knapp and james lakatsky report hitchhiker effects among many of the scientists that studied at skinwalker ranch in fact the phenomenon often followed these people home

link.difference: Credits the claim to the book Skinwalkers at the Pentagon by Kelleher, Knapp and Lacatski, and names it the 'hitchhiker effect'.
